page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head above and the catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: quendam fingularem & pietatem crepantibus, ducuntur, fed id ferio expetunt fcire, quàm folidis Argumentis, & vivis rationibus tùm divinis, tum humanis, tantarum Novationum præceps Impetus & neceffitas poffit fusten-tari.

At in iftis quidem Propofitionibus animad-verto hujus generis perpauca vel in hunc prorfus finem. Nil in Legibus luxatum quod hîc volunt restitui, nulla Juris alieni ufurpatio abdicanda, nulla Justitiæ obstructio removenda, nulla omnino Injuriarum Compensatio, vel quicquam æquæ hujusmodi Reformationis rogatur, cui vel Ratio vel Religio, vel Prudentia Politica, vel Humanum quodcunque Argumentum ad annuendum impellat.

Quod vero ad summam eorum attinet, quæ diversis temporibus perhibita, nova maximè & difficilia videbantur, id demum perspexi, ea, quæ olim in Regno seditiones & Ecclesiæ Schismata habita ac legibus propterea obnoxia, jam eò usque fiduciæ pervenisse (vulgi scilicet clamoribus & auxilio præcipuè propugnata) ut non satis habeant, ipsa, cum vanitate sua, novitate, confusione tolerari, nisi hoc insuper requirant, ut Leges omnes contra Illos abrogentur, quin & Regimen Illud extirpeur[?], cujus Jura jam quæfrunt invadere.
Hoc ad summum eorum quæ petunt: Cæ-tera feré sunt chartæ ineptæ & supervacuæ, in quibus ista involvunt ideo, ut honestius pau-lo afferantur.

page.notes: The running head is Greek, printed ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ; the final letter is read as Η. The word "extirpeur" is doubtful and is marked [?]. The word "quæfrunt" in the third paragraph is a misreading in my transcription and should read "quærunt"; the printed word is "quaerunt". The catchword "Mihi" is at the lower right. Long s has been normalised to s throughout, and u/v and i/j have been regularised.
